[[File:Arkham Horror The Card Game logo.png|thumb|Original Arkham Horror LCG: Chapter Two game logo.]]
'''Arkham Horror LCG: Chapter Two''' is the 2026 core release of the cooperative ''Arkham Horror'' card game. The [[TCGMix]] playtest covers the three-scenario Brethren of Ash campaign and carries investigator trauma and deck upgrades from one scenario to the next.<ref name="catalog" />

== History ==

The original Core Set went on general sale in November 2016, after its debut at Arkham Nights the previous month.<ref name="arkdebut" /><ref name="arkfirst" /> Nate French and MJ Newman designed the original game.<ref name="arkrules" /> Fantasy Flight Games released a new Core Set on 20 March 2026 to open Chapter Two. The new box includes the three-scenario ''Brethren of Ash'' campaign. Its rulebook credits Josiah “Duke” Harrist and Nicholas Kory for design and development of the new core.<ref name="arkrelease" /><ref name="arkrules" />

== Gameplay ==

Investigators use decks of cards to gather clues, confront enemies and advance the act of a scenario while the encounter deck and doom advance its agenda.<ref name="arkrules" />

== Online play ==

Players can [https://tcgmix.com/arkhamlcg/ open the game on TCGMix].<ref name="tcgmix-play-arkham-horror-lcg-chapter-two">[https://tcgmix.com/arkhamlcg/ Play Arkham Horror LCG: Chapter Two], TCGMix. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107194022/https://tcgmix.com/arkhamlcg/ Internet Archive].</ref>
